verdicts.reason: A sets the headline on one line, centred on the horizontal axis, at a strong size for the banner, with even side margins; the one flaw is that it sits a little high, so the top margin is tighter than the bottom. B's headline is noticeably smaller and shifted left of centre (about x 172–522 on a 768 canvas), which leaves an uneven large empty area on the right and weakens the one statement that carries the whole design.
